{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden has been a strong and unequivocal voice speaking out against rising antisemitism in America.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration released the first-ever National Strategy to Counter Antisemitism, outlining a whole-of-society effort, including unprecedented, coordinated, and bold actions across government agencies, and calls to action for Congress, state and local governments, companies, technology platforms, and others.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration clarified, for the first time in writing, that Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 prohibits certain forms of antisemitic, Islamophobic, and related discrimination, including discrimination by national origin, in federally funded programs and activities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden continues to take bold action to combat antisemitism on college campuses.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden prioritized fighting antisemitism abroad by appointing Deborah Lipstadt as U.S. Special Envoy to monitor and combat antisemitism, an ambassador-level position.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
